working_account.text:
Task: Add InterpolationMissingOptionError tests via real ConfigParser.get under BasicInterpolation and ExtendedInterpolation (incl. cross-section). Cover copy/deepcopy/pickle, raw=True, successful lookup. Also doc examples.

Strategy: Single new test class InterpolationMissingOptionErrorTransportTestCase inserted before MiscTestCase. Covers all required cases in one patch. Then doc patch triggers public check.

Key facts:
- e.args = (option, section, rawval, reference)
- e.option, e.section, e.reference are separate attributes
- str(e) = str(e.args) for multi-arg exception
- Basic: %(name)s syntax, map lookup → KeyError
- Extended: ${name} or ${section:name}, KeyError/NoSectionError/NoOptionError
- ExtendedInterpolation uses default_section='common' in test class
- raw=True returns unresolved value without interpolation
- 2 requests left, 53 actions left
